basic_details.job_title: DLSA Sidhi Para Legal Volunteers Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

content_sections.text: Advt No. 699/जिविसेप्रा/26 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DLSA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: At least Class 12th pass Age limit: No age limit: a person of any age may apply, provided the person is healthy and has no physical defect that makes them unable to do the work Other conditions: Must be healthy with no physical defect that makes the person unable to work Applicant declares no conviction by any competent court and no criminal case pending Form asks which Gram Panchayat / Janpad the applicant wishes to work in Desirable: Priority to teachers including retired teachers, retired government servants and senior citizens Priority to MSW students and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors Priority to students and law students not enrolled as advocates Priority to members of NGOs, clubs, women's groups, Maitri Sanghs and self-help groups Priority to long-sentenced prisoners with good behaviour in jail

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DLSA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: No salary or wages are payable; an honorarium fixed from time to time under the directions of the State Authority will be paid to Para Legal Volunteers. Selection is for one year Purely service work, not a job; no salary or wages payable

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview of eligible candidates by the Selection Committee at District Court Sidhi Selection Committee at District Court Sidhi selects eligible candidates through interview Separate intimation will be issued to candidates for the interview Committee has full right to reject any application; its decision is final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of educational qualification Aadhaar / Voter identity card Proof of social work experience Certificate of special achievement or work One additional passport size photograph Other certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format attached with the notice. Attach one passport size photograph and the listed enclosures. Submit at the office of District Legal Services Authority Sidhi by 30-11-2026, 5:00 PM. Or send by post/courier to Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, District Court Sidhi. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Issued by order of the Principal District and Sessions Judge / Chairman

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for DLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form attached with the notice (page 2 of this PDF)) and send it to Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, District Court Sidhi (M.P.), by by hand at the dlsa sidhi office, or by post/courier, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for DLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No salary or wages; an honorarium fixed from time to time under the directions of the State Authority is payable.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: At least Class 12th pass.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be healthy with no physical defect that makes the person unable to work. Applicant declares no conviction by any competent court and no criminal case pending. Form asks which Gram Panchayat / Janpad the applicant wishes to work in.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview of eligible candidates by the Selection Committee at District Court Sidhi. Selection Committee at District Court Sidhi selects eligible candidates through interview. Separate intimation will be issued to candidates for the interview. Committee has full right to reject any application; its decision is final.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is for one year. Purely service work, not a job; no salary or wages payable.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Villages, tehsils and district of Sidhi (legal aid clinics and police stations).

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate of educational qualification; Aadhaar / Voter identity card; Proof of social work experience; Certificate of special achievement or work; One additional passport size photograph; Other certificates.
